note: Family-run motel on US 8 at the east edge of Barron with a small RV campground in a grass loop behind it: about 8 full-hookup pull-through sites and a few electric-only sites for small campers and tents, a bathhouse and a play area. A rail line passes just north. No rate is posted; a camper reported paying $39 with tax for a full-hookup pull-through in August 2024 (Campendium review). --Claude
summary: Operator site (no rates/season), Campendium (dated Aug 2024 nightly stay at $39 with tax), Good Sam directory, RV Life ($$), Google 4.4 (101) and imagery read. A motel that DOES sell drive-in RV sites by the night: ~8 FHU pull-throughs + ~6 electric back-ins in a loop behind the motel. Passes price (RV Life $$; camper $39) and presence (website + phone). Season changed from year-round (note-derived) to May 1 - Oct 1 (directory, reported). Not waterfront. Pin OK.
flags: Nightly confirmed (the brief's question): Campendium review dated August 19, 2024: 'How much for the pull-thru FHU? $39.00 with tax (8/17/24)', 3 nights stayed, 'This is great for a night or two', 'approx. 8 pull thru sites with FHUs, and about 6 sites that have electric (back-in)'. No sign of seasonal or monthly RV sites (the operator offers 'contractor rates' for motel rooms only). Long-stay tests: not a long-stay park.

Price gate: passes. No operator rate; RV Life $$ (avg $36) satisfies the price indicator; camper-reported $39 with tax (Aug 2024) and Good Sam directory 'From $35 / night'. Fees left unwritten (operator page exists but posts no rate, so the camper report goes only in the note).
Presence: operator website live with phone 715-637-3154; Google 4.4 (101 reviews). Not a Good Sam Park (good_sam false stands).

SEASON CHANGE: stored year_round true (derived from old note prose) is unsupported by the operator page; Good Sam 'Open May 1 - Oct 1' and Campendium 'Open seasonally spring - fall' agree it is seasonal. Written as reported May 1 - Oct 1; reviewer may prefer to clear season instead.
Sites: the operator gives 8 full-service plus 'several' 110-volt sites; Campendium 17, RV Life 16, the camper ~14. Count left unwritten.
Not waterfront confirmed (motel lot on US 8). Pin OK: stored 45.4017,-91.8309 is ~80 m SE of the RV loop (about 45.4025,-91.8315).
Inclusion evidence describes this campground and is still accurate.
